title: Sandfall Blocks
description: Drop vibrant blocks that shatter into flowing grains of colored sand on impact—connect a single color edge-to-edge to trigger huge cascading clears.
controls: Drag one of the three sand blocks at the bottom into the playfield; bridge left-to-right with one sand color to clear it.

zh-CN.title: 流沙俄罗斯方块
zh-CN.description: 极致解压的物理落沙消除：方块落地瞬间化作流动的细沙堆叠，只要同色沙层连通左右两边即可整片爽快消除。
zh-CN.controls: 从底部拖出彩色方块松手下落，利用流沙自然滑落的特性让同色沙子贯通左右两侧即可连消得分。
